updates.title: CVE-2026-69851: Microsoft Entra ID Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in Azure Active Directory allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges over the network. Admins should apply available security updates immediately to prevent unauthorized privilege escalation in their identity infrastructure.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69836: Microsoft Entra ID Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
updates.summary: Unsafe deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Entra ID allows unauthorized attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely. This critical vulnerability requires immediate patching to prevent account compromise and lateral movement within identity systems.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: File Quarantine Action for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: A new File Quarantine action in DLP policies for SharePoint and OneDrive automatically moves flagged files to a restricted, admin-controlled quarantine location when violations are detected, instantly revoking user access while preserving content for investigation. This delivers immediate containment of sensitive data exposure without requiring manual intervention.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Web Search Protection for Microsoft 365 Copilot
updates.summary: DLP policies now extend to Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat, preventing sensitive data from being used in external web searches in real time. This enhancement helps organizations mitigate data leakage risks when employees use Copilot features for research or queries.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Policy Tips in Outlook for Mac
updates.summary: DLP policy tips now display in Outlook for Mac's mail tip UI, alerting users in real time when their emails contain sensitive information that violates policy. Users can remove non-compliant recipients or request override before sending, extending compliance controls to Mac users.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Permissions Audit Log Improvements
updates.summary: Enhanced audit logging for Microsoft Purview portal access provides clearer visibility into role and scoped-role authorization decisions, helping administrators troubleshoot access issues and track who accessed what resources and when. This improves accountability and governance over privileged portal operations.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Triage Agent Confidence Scoring and Reasoning Trace
updates.summary: The Data Security Triage Agent in DLP now includes confidence scores and reasoning trace explanations for its alert decisions, enabling SOC teams to understand and trust automation outcomes. This reduces false positives and manual review burden by providing auditable, explainable AI-driven triage.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Retention Based on Last Accessed Date for OneDrive and SharePoint
updates.summary: Admins can now apply retention rules to SharePoint and OneDrive files based on their last access date, enabling smarter data lifecycle policies that target stale or inactive content. This allows organizations to retain frequently used files longer while accelerating disposal of unused data.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery: Select SharePoint Embedded Container as Data Source
updates.summary: eDiscovery users can now view and select SharePoint Embedded containers owned by specific users as investigation data sources, enabling search and collection of content from Loop, Copilot Pages, and Copilot Notebooks. This closes a gap in eDiscovery scope for modern collaboration content.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery: Customer-Managed Key for Direct Export
updates.summary: eDiscovery direct export now supports customer-managed key (CMK) encryption, allowing organizations to control their own encryption keys for exported discovery data alongside existing Microsoft-managed encryption. This enhances compliance and control over sensitive investigation data in regulated industries.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Triage Agent Summaries in Microsoft Defender XDR
updates.summary: DLP alert summaries and categorizations from the Data Security Triage Agent are now available in Microsoft Defender XDR's DLP alerts view, centralizing AI-driven triage context alongside other security signals. This enables SOC teams to investigate data loss incidents more efficiently within their security operations platform.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Retention for Copilot Memory
updates.summary: Administrators can now configure retention policies for Microsoft 365 Copilot memory items stored in users' Exchange mailboxes, preserving historical versions for security, compliance, and investigation purposes. This provides visibility and control over AI-generated memory data alongside active memory management.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Hard Delete via Priority Cleanup Workflows
updates.summary: Hard delete capability for OneDrive and SharePoint is now available through secure priority cleanup workflows with enhanced approval controls to prevent accidental data loss. Admins can now permanently remove sensitive or regulated content after compliance review, with audit trails documenting the deletion process.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62827: Microsoft SharePoint Server Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: Improper authentication in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows authorized attackers to escalate their privileges over the network. Organizations running SharePoint on-premises should apply security updates to prevent privilege escalation attacks.

updates.title: CVE-2026-63512: Microsoft SharePoint Server Tampering Vulnerability
updates.summary: Incorrect authorization in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows authorized attackers to tamper with data and content over the network. Admins should patch their SharePoint installations to prevent unauthorized modifications to collaborative content.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Sensitivity Labels: Simulation Mode for Auto-Labeling
updates.summary: Auto-labeling policies can now run in simulation mode before enforcement, allowing admins to preview which items will be labeled and review match results and data distribution without making changes. This reduces risk of over-labeling or misclassification before policies go live.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Sensitivity Labels: Insights Tab for Auto-Labeling Policies
updates.summary: An Insights tab in auto-labeling policy details now provides at-a-glance performance metrics, showing different data depending on whether the policy is in simulation or enforcement mode. This helps administrators understand labeling effectiveness and identify improvement opportunities.
